summary: Drugs Made In America Acquisition Corp., a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing that on September 8, 2026 it entered into an Amended and Restated Definitive Merger Agreement with Power Analytics Global Corp, an AI, analytics and quantum-resistant security business. The filing implements a US de-SPAC: domesticating the SPAC to Delaware, then merging Merger Sub into PAGC, replacing the prior valuation-milestone framework with a fixed close construct. No price per share, premium, ownership split or outside date is disclosed in the excerpt; all economics and closing conditions, break fees and regulatory clocks remain to be confirmed in the filed exhibits and registration statement. Watch for redemption levels, PIPE support, Nasdaq listing terms and the proxy timeline.
